execution_plan_smoke_observation.IS_NOT_A_PLAN_DIGEST: This value authorizes nothing and must never be submitted to Platform CP, frozen by Deployment Control, or compared against a production ExecutionPlanDigestV1. It is the digest of a THROWAWAY plan rendered against this repository's own reference descriptor and a fictitious target, for the sole purpose of proving the installed wheel can produce a digest at all. A real plan digest is bound to a real target and a real descriptor; this is bound to neither.
